stories.title: Trump upends bipartisan housing bill, leaving lawmakers scrambling
stories.summary: President Trump has cancelled a signing planned for today of the 21st Century Road to Housing Act, the largest housing affordability in decades passed with overwhelming bipartisan support in Congress.

stories.title: For vaccine information, some pediatricians are finding ways to sidestep Trump's CDC
stories.summary: The Trump administration's efforts to stop recommending some childhood vaccines has created a dilemma for pediatricians. Some are actively steering patients away from the CDC website.

stories.title: Camp Mystic files for bankruptcy almost a year after catastrophic Texas floods
stories.summary: Camp Mystic, the all-girls Christian Texas summer camp, where 28 people died during the catastrophic floods last year filed for bankruptcy reorganization on Wednesday.

stories.title: A volunteer otter watcher helped make a scientific discovery
stories.summary: A man who volunteered as an otter spotter made some scientific discoveries along the way.

stories.title: U.S. military works on building a better meal for the troops
stories.summary: The drone-infested battlefields of modern warfare and the need to make troops' loads lighter has the U.S. military looking for new forms of field rations, like ways to make protein on the front lines.

stories.title: High gas prices hurt, even if you travel by rubber raft
stories.summary: River trips require car and truck shuttles to get floaters from the end back to where they started. High gas prices have some cancelling their plans.
